subject.title: Cron "New Job" form misaligns the Description field after interacting with Agent ID

question: Which product surface owns the Cron New Job editor with Name, Description, and Agent ID fields?
rationale: Current ClawHub main and v0.23.1 do not contain that form, so automation cannot safely choose a fix location or close this as implemented without maintainer routing.

options.title: Route outside current ClawHub
options.body: Treat this as belonging to another OpenClaw branch, repository, or private/demo dashboard until a ClawHub source path is supplied.

options.title: Attach the current ClawHub path
options.body: Keep this issue open with a route, screenshot, fixture, or branch that exposes the form so a focused UI regression can be written.

options.title: Fold into cron-template planning
options.body: If the form is planned as part of https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/86, carry the alignment regression into that future UI work rather than guessing a standalone fix now.

recommendation.title: Route outside current ClawHub
recommendation.body: Treat this as belonging to another OpenClaw branch, repository, or private/demo dashboard until a ClawHub source path is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest adjacent history across the dashboard baseline and internal cron surface, making them the best available router for whether this belongs in current ClawHub.
